matches.name: multiplyFixedPointQuaternions
matches.behavior: Combines two 3D turns into one orientation, using fixed-point quaternion math.
matches.evidence: Four component products and sums implement the Hamilton product; all fields are staged before writing the output.
matches.uncertainty: Quaternion composition is clear; callers and its exact gameplay use are not established.

matches.name: buildPerspectiveProjectionMatrix
matches.behavior: Builds the 3D camera perspective: field of view, screen proportions, and near/far visibility limits.
matches.evidence: Computes a cotangent from sine/cosine, uses aspect and near/far values, and fills a 4 by 4 projection matrix.
matches.uncertainty: The exact projection convention and scaleW purpose are inferred from matrix equations; some helper names remain address based.

matches.name: startStereoPcmStream
matches.behavior: Starts left and right movie-audio playback buffers and schedules their sound timer.
matches.evidence: Sets up two looping sound channels, flushes both buffers, and starts a periodic alarm/timer.
matches.uncertainty: The refill callback behavior is outside this function; exact stream format constants are opaque.

matches.name: classifyPackedShapeFlags
matches.behavior: Maps two packed two-bit end codes to a shape flag.
matches.evidence: Switches on masked bits 31..30 and 15..14 and returns one of four constants.
matches.uncertainty: The wider caller meaning of the returned shape flags is unknown.

matches.name: relocateFontResource
matches.behavior: Prepares a loaded font so the game can find character shapes, widths, and character mappings.
matches.evidence: Walks NFTR sections and rebases fields for FINF, CWDH and CMAP blocks; CGLP has no rebased fields.
matches.uncertainty: NFTR section structure is recognizable from tags; malformed input handling is not established.
